name: System proxy settings
plain: Reads the HTTP proxy configured on the device.
meaning: Shows corporate or debugging proxies and can indicate traffic inspection.

ios.api_surface: Dictionary of HTTP, HTTPS, PAC settings

limits.headline: Can see if your phone sends web traffic through a proxy
limits.user_action: Nothing. It happens when the app opens a network connection
can: See the proxy host, port and any PAC script address
Route its traffic through the same proxy
Spot a work or school network setup
cannot: See the traffic that goes through the proxy
See a proxy set by a VPN app in every case

story.what_it_is: An app can see whether your phone sends its web traffic through a proxy.
story.for_you: You do not see it. If you use a work or school network with a proxy, apps can tell. It may show that someone is inspecting the traffic of your phone, or that a developer is testing.
story.for_makers: Makers use it to help with support and to spot tools that sit between the app and the server. Banks and games use the flag to detect people who intercept traffic to cheat. It is a weak but useful signal.

use_cases.example: A work app notes that the phone uses a company proxy and picks safe settings.
A bank app refuses to run when a proxy is set, to stop someone reading its traffic.
A mobile game blocks players who use a proxy tool to edit the game's messages.
A developer sets a proxy on a test phone to watch the app's requests and fix a bug.
A fraud tool sees a proxy that matches a known scam setup and raises the risk score.
A support tool shows a help article when a proxy breaks the connection.

story.android_note: Android apps can read the system proxy setting with no prompt.
story.ios_note: iPhone apps can read the system proxy settings through the network settings, with no prompt.
